generationAssessment.groupInventory: Full measured births are collected for each sample; unavailable group samples fail before owned-native census/accounting.
generationAssessment.nativeRSS: An extra read for a verified registered instance retains its expected PID/startSec/startUsec. Unknown identity/RSS raises; only proven gone/replaced generations yield zero.
generationAssessment.originalDeniedPID: Same opaque PID tag in all three partial attempts, no full identity/birth. Same process generation and role are unproven.

processBoundary.assessment: The outer monitor ps is outside the target group under this launch invariant. The native harness ps remains a distinct supported denial hypothesis.
processBoundary.harnessSampler: native_suite subprocesses, HostProcess._process_rows ps and ShimMonitor ps inherit the target group.
processBoundary.monitorSampler: Runner.group_activity subprocess.run(ps) inherits the monitor parent PGID.
processBoundary.monitoredStage: Runner.run Popen(start_new_session=True) creates a distinct target PGID equal to its child PID.
processBoundary.selection: DarwinActivity.group selects only exact target PGID inventory rows; libproc validates live membership/UID and full identity.

supportedDefect.notOriginalCause: The original run failed earlier and its native registry observed zero hosts/Shims/helpers. This defect is not attributed as the original EPERM or native-exit cause.
